verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Terminal accepts contactless payments on a compatible iPhone or Android device through the Terminal SDK, so no separate reader is needed. There is a dedicated Tap to Pay on iPhone setup guide, and founders who don't want to code can accept payments from the Stripe Dashboard mobile app. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Tap to Pay in practice, Android-specific setup documentation and device-compatibility/regional availability details.
